title: CLCON/140/2016 of Kartik Mazumdar Vs Ashish Bhatgai

paras.text:
CLCON No. 140 of 2016
U.C. Dhyani, J. Mr. M.C. Kandpal, Sr. Advocate assisted by Mr.
Maneesh Bisht, Advocate for the petitioner.
By means of present contempt petition, the
petitioner seek to punish the respondent / opposite party
for committing deliberate and willful disobedience of
the order dated 18.03.2016, passed by this Court in
Writ petition no. 685 (M/S) of 2016, titled as Kartik
Mazumdar vs State of Uttarakhand and another.
The operative portion of the order sought to be
executed is being reproduced here-in-below for
convenience:
"Looking at the record of the case, writ petition
is disposed of by requesting the appellate court to make
an endeavour to decide the above said Appeal no.
52/02, Year 2014-15 (old no. 52/19, Year 2014-15), at
an early date. The same does not mean that the case
shall be given an out of turn hearing and will have
precedence over other similarly situated cases. The
appellate court has only to keep in mind the fact that
present Original Suit, which is of the year 2015, does
not lose track and is not ignored in the backdrop of a
large number of pending cases in said court."
It is the submission of learned counsel for the
petitioner that the casual approach on the part of
respondent should not be tolerated and strict action
should be initiated against the alleged contemnor.
This Court, instead of issuing notice to the
respondent / opposite party, reiterates the order dated
18.03.2016, passed by the Court and directs the
respondent / opposite party to comply with the order
dated 18.03.2016.
Petitioner is directed to place a copy of this
order, as also the order dated 18.03.2016 to remind the
respondent that an endeavour has to be made by him to
decide the Appeal no. 52/02, year 2014-15 (old no.
52/19, Year 2014-15).
With the observation as above, the contempt
petition stands disposed of.
